# Capture

> Experimental MIT macOS voice/text inbox. Local retained audio, optional explicit whisper.cpp transcription, original neutral and Pip appearances, Core/Plus variants. No hosted core account or telemetry.

- [Releases](https://github.com/Ghostzy0/pip-capture/releases)

Transcription may be wrong. Source recall quotes matching text and is not generative semantic answering. Actual microphone, platform and accessibility acceptance must be read from TESTING. Weights are separate. No affiliation with referenced products is implied. This file is a documentation index, not a discoverability or ranking guarantee.
